name: German-Style Sausage Bake with Potato, Apple, Sauerkraut & Curried Mayo (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter new potatoes and place in a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Add to the bowl with the potatoes.
Quarter, core, and large dice apples. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Slice sausages crosswise into 1-inch thick rounds. Add to the bowl, along with oil and spices, then stir to combine. Transfer mixture to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until the potatoes are tender and sausage is cooked through, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, water, and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the ranch dressing and set aside for the kid plates.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅛ tsp dill, dried
⅛ tsp parsley flakes
garlic powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo, water, curry powder, and salt in another small bowl. Stir to combine the curried mayo and set aside for the adult plates.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp curry powder
salt

instructions.primary_message: When the sausage bake has about 5 minutes left, place sauerkraut in a small saucepan. Set over high heat and bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Cover and remove from heat to keep warm.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 2 ½ cups of sausage-veggie bake between plates, separating the different foods and removing the onion if desired. Serve with ranch dressing. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining sausage-veggie bake and sauerkraut between plates. Drizzle with curried mayo and enjoy!
